messages:
alex: Customer hit quickstart friction: accepted invite, added card, UI shows "Ready", but first API call returns 402 then later succeeds. They think setup is finished.

mei: Which sample and SDK version?

alex: React quickstart, SDK pinned to 0.9.0. Their curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_ABC" -d '{"model":"redwood/tiny","input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> 402 {"error":"billing_required"} then 200 after ~25s.

core-infra: billing attach webhook median ~10s, p95 ~40s. Sample app currently flips to Ready when account created, not when billing attached.

mei: SDK in 0.9.0 retries on HTTP errors; we should not auto-retry on 4xx billing errors. Causes extra noise and user anxiety about charges.

alex: Customer worried about duplicate charges and misleading Ready state.

core-infra: Proposed fixes: (1) sample app show "Finalizing payment, please wait" until workspace.provisioned, (2) SDK default: do not retry on 400-499 except 429.

mei: I'll open SDK patch and tests.

support-bot: Ticket SUP-2231 created to notify customer and confirm no duplicate billing.

alex: Thanks — will update docs quickstart note about ~1 minute provisioning window.
